text: The authors state that their weak and strong models differ only in pretrained model size, whereas future stronger models may differ in reasoning and planning; that the compute gap is not large (7B vs 14B); that conclusions should be checked on larger models such as Qwen2-72B; and that the approach is expensive because it needs two debater instances and multi-turn debate.
title: Weak and strong models differ only in size (Qwen 7B vs 14B); method is expensive
